speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The combination of a continuous heart murmur (suggestive of patent ductus arteriosus), bluish non-blanching macules (petechiae), and cloudy lenses (cataracts) is known as the classic triad for this condition.
